name: @stewardmd/capacitor-prep-sound
description: PrepNucleus Sound native bridge (Android only). Foreground media-playback service with platform MediaSession/MediaPlayer for first-party ambient loops, plus Keystore AES-GCM secure storage for the Spotify refresh token. Exposed to JS as Capacitor.Plugins.PrepSound. iOS is intentionally unsupported: the web player is used there.
author: StewardMD
